hermeticity.method: I first reconstructed focus-only models from 100:1 and its complete supplied branch inventories, then tested context roots in packet order for changes that remained attached to عَٰدِيَٰتِ or ضَبْحًا. Distinct mechanisms were retained without forcing a single referent or final interpretation.
hermeticity.limitations: This is a reconstructed focus trace because the sealed packet exposed the focus ayah and all context at once, not a strict staged discovery log. Split-root activations are packet-supplied possibilities rather than claims that the focus form historically derives from every mapped root; causal arrows and contrasts are identified as reader inferences.

ع د و root_000993 B011 (summer herbage) and ك ن د root_001321 B003 (barren ground) suggested an ecological reversal, but the causal link from running/breath to fertility or barrenness was not supplied strongly enough to retain.

ق د ح root_001203 B002-B003 (defect and lineage attack) could moralize the scene, but they do not alter a focus word or construction as cleanly as the ignition branch.
The referent of the feminine plural was intentionally not disambiguated; horse, human, or other-agent identification would add material absent from the sealed packet.

strongest_changes: 100:2 turns a strange focus-internal scorching branch into a strong motion-to-ignition sequence.
100:3-5 give the focus a complete edge-to-center incursion geometry whose passage changes matter and leaves a dust wake.
100:4 and 100:7-11 recast breath and wake as witnessing traces through which concealed interiors become knowable.
100:6-8 make bodily expenditure coexist with two moral readings: a counterimage of responsiveness and a mirror of intensity bound to acquisition.
Split-root return, count, and readiness branches remain live exploratory models because later assembly, uncovering, and collection visibly reactivate them.
summary.what_was_special: The focus is unusually generative because its two roots bridge motion, boundary crossing, recurrence, counting, breath, scorching, discoloration, and ash. Context does not collapse that plurality: it serializes some branches into ignition and incursion, then reverses the opening's outward emissions into an epistemology of traces, exposure, and interior knowledge.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the focus's thermal ض ب ح branches are an intended material register or only a productive root-inventory analogy.
Whether the opening plurality is a positive counterimage to human ingratitude or a mirror of the same acquisitive intensity.
How much interpretive weight the non-dominant ع و د and ع د د mappings can bear beyond exploratory resonance.
Whether breath discloses only physical exertion or also functions as a proleptic sign of motive and interior state.
The packet does not settle the concrete referent of the feminine plural, and the retained mechanisms do not require settling it.
